_doc: Static file inventory for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 is empty — page1's scaffold doesn't read any files. Phase B+ will populate this with the eight file_templates that back the eight planned layers (assembly_stats.json, chromosome_map.json, gene_track.gff, repeat_track.bed, conserved_elements.bed, synteny_blocks.json, centromere_telomere.json, variant_annotations.json).
